## E — Market signal

Status: no market research was performed for this section; the upstream competitive-intelligence pointer was not supplied for this run, so market size, pass rate, rooms, voice-of-customer quotes, persona, seasonality, price and success bar are recorded as typed debt (verify — MD-SEC-TWELVE-E-MARKET).
Known context only from the product frame: buyers are first-time Maryland applicants and the parents of teen drivers preparing for the MVA knowledge test.
Section angle: supervising-driver, child-seat and insurance rules matter to parents as well as learners, so the market pass should check how buyers ask about these practical requirements.
Ad hooks, verbatim learner pain phrases and a named differentiation gap must come from sourced recon in a later pass, never invented here.
